limitations: Synthetic household, plan, providers, services and fees only; no real people, brands, billing codes or member data.
The App records facts, statuses, amounts and consequences; it does not decide medical necessity, rank options or say what the right action is.
Member-facing business GUI on the shared local Web Host (gui/); claims, prior authorizations and plan decisions arrive as scenario events, and there are no provider or plan screens.

Time is the environment's: no clock event and no scheduler. Claim review, request expiry, PA validity, decision due dates and the window-closing notice are due times on each record, applied from the supplied virtual time.
Pharmacy claims belong to Mendwell Pharmacy and are refused here; pharmacy prior authorizations are recorded.
Approvals (user.confirmed) come from Infra, never from the page: the GUI shows a waiting state until Refresh finds the approval.
No attachments or media: resources are not used.
